en: at first; at the outset; originally

example_pinyin: Qǐchū tā bú tài shìyìng xīn huánjìng.
example_en: At first he didn't adapt well to the new environment.

en: starting point; starting point (of a race); starting point
example_zh: 比赛的起点在公园门口。
example_pinyin: Bǐsài de qǐdiǎn zài gōngyuán ménkǒu.
example_en: The starting point of the race is at the park gate.

en: to originate; to originate from; origin; to come from
example_zh: 这个节日起源于古代。
example_pinyin: Zhège jiérì qǐyuán yú gǔdài.
example_en: This festival originated in ancient times.

example_zh: 晚会上的气氛很热闹。
example_pinyin: Wǎnhuì shàng de qìfēn hěn rènao.
example_en: The atmosphere at the party was lively.

example_zh: 空气是多种气体的混合。
example_pinyin: Kōngqì shì duō zhǒng qìtǐ de hùnhé.
example_en: Air is a mixture of several gases.

example_zh: 花的气味很好闻。
example_pinyin: Huā de qìwèi hěn hǎo wén.
example_en: The scent of the flowers smells lovely.

example_zh: 她有艺术家的气质。
example_pinyin: Tā yǒu yìshùjiā de qìzhì.
example_en: She has an artist's temperament.

example_zh: 他用了一个恰当的例子。
example_pinyin: Tā yòngle yí ge qiàdàng de lìzi.
example_en: He used an appropriate example.

en: just right; just in time; just enough; as it happens
example_zh: 你来得恰好，一起吃饭。
example_pinyin: Nǐ lái de qiàhǎo, yìqǐ chīfàn.
example_en: You've come at just the right moment; let's eat together.

example_zh: 他说的恰恰是我想问的。
example_pinyin: Tā shuō de qiàqià shì wǒ xiǎng wèn de.
example_en: What he said was exactly what I wanted to ask.

en: a great many households; numerous families
example_zh: 电视走进了千家万户。
example_pinyin: Diànshì zǒu jìnle qiānjiā-wànhù.
example_en: Television has entered countless households.

en: to lead along; to pull; to involve; to concern (牵)
example_zh: 他牵着狗去散步。
example_pinyin: Tā qiānzhe gǒu qù sànbù.
example_en: He takes his dog for a walk on a leash.

en: modest; self-effacing; modest; to make modest remarks
example_zh: 他成绩好却很谦虚。
example_pinyin: Tā chéngjì hǎo què hěn qiānxū.
example_en: He has good grades but is modest.

example_zh: 这个行业的前景很好。
example_pinyin: Zhège hángyè de qiánjǐng hěn hǎo.
example_en: The prospects for this industry are good.

en: earlier stage; early stage; preliminary period
example_zh: 项目前期的准备很充分。
example_pinyin: Xiàngmù qiánqī de zhǔnbèi hěn chōngfèn.
example_en: The preparation in the early stage of the project was thorough.

example_zh: 安全是工作的前提。
example_pinyin: Ānquán shì gōngzuò de qiántí.
example_en: Safety is the prerequisite of work.

example_zh: 苹果和橘子，前者更甜。
example_pinyin: Píngguǒ hé júzi, qiánzhě gèng tián.
example_en: Of apples and oranges, the former is sweeter.

example_zh: 这个学生潜力很大。
example_pinyin: Zhège xuéshēng qiánlì hěn dà.
example_en: This student has great potential.

example_zh: 射击比赛用的是枪。
example_pinyin: Shèjǐ bǐsài yòng de shì qiāng.
example_en: Guns are used in shooting competitions.

en: to strengthen; to intensify; to consolidate; strengthened
example_zh: 学校强化了安全管理。
example_pinyin: Xuéxiào qiánghuàle ānquán guǎnlǐ.
example_en: The school strengthened safety management.

example_zh: 经常锻炼让他很强壮。
example_pinyin: Jīngcháng duànliàn ràng tā hěn qiángzhuàng.
example_en: Regular exercise has made him strong.

example_zh: 教室的墙壁是白色的。
example_pinyin: Jiàoshì de qiángbì shì báisè de.
example_en: The classroom walls are white.

en: to force; to compel; to impose; to oblige
example_zh: 不要强迫孩子学习。
example_pinyin: Búyào qiǎngpò háizi xuéxí.
example_en: Don't force children to study.

example_zh: 这座桥梁连接两个村子。
example_pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáoliáng liánjiē liǎng ge cūnzi.
example_en: This bridge connects the two villages.

en: to look at; to see; to look (瞧)
example_zh: 你瞧，天边有一道彩虹。
example_pinyin: Nǐ qiáo, tiānbiān yǒu yí dào cǎihóng.
example_en: Look, there's a rainbow on the horizon.

example_zh: 他用巧妙的方法解决了问题。
example_pinyin: Tā yòng qiǎomiào de fāngfǎ jiějuéle wèntí.
example_en: He solved the problem in an ingenious way.
example_cloze: 他用＿＿的方法解决了问题。

example_zh: 这个计划切实可行。
example_pinyin: Zhège jìhuà qièshí kěxíng.
example_en: This plan is practical and feasible.

example_zh: 她们是亲密的朋友。
example_pinyin: Tāmen shì qīnmì de péngyou.
example_en: They are close friends.

example_zh: 他的亲属都在外地。
example_pinyin: Tā de qīnshǔ dōu zài wàidì.
example_en: His relatives are all in another part of the country.

example_zh: 农民是很勤劳的。
example_pinyin: Nóngmín shì hěn qínláo de.
example_en: Farmers are very hardworking.

example_zh: 他把青春留在了山区。
example_pinyin: Tā bǎ qīngchūn liú zài le shānqū.
example_en: He left his youth in the mountain region.

example_zh: 青春期是成长的重要阶段。
example_pinyin: Qīngchūnqī shì chéngzhǎng de zhòngyào jiēduàn.
example_en: Adolescence is an important stage of growing up.

en: to listen attentively; to listen carefully
example_zh: 老师认真倾听每个学生说话。
example_pinyin: Lǎoshī rènzhēn qīngtīng měi ge xuéshēng shuōhuà.
example_en: The teacher listens carefully to every student.
example_cloze: 老师认真＿＿每个学生说话。

en: tendency; trend; to incline; to tend to
example_zh: 他倾向于早起锻炼。
example_pinyin: Tā qīngxiàng yú zǎoqǐ duànliàn.
example_en: He tends to get up early to exercise.

en: clear; clean; to clean up; to settle (accounts) (清)
example_zh: 这条小河的水很清。
example_pinyin: Zhè tiáo xiǎo hé de shuǐ hěn qīng.
example_en: The water in this stream is very clear.

example_zh: 清晨的公园很安静。
example_pinyin: Qīngchén de gōngyuán hěn ānjìng.
example_en: The park is very quiet in the early morning.

en: light (of food); not strong (of taste); mild; slack (清淡)
example_zh: 他喜欢吃清淡的食物。
example_pinyin: Tā xǐhuan chī qīngdàn de shíwù.
example_en: He likes eating mildly flavored food.

example_zh: 保持教室清洁很重要。
example_pinyin: Bǎochí jiàoshì qīngjié hěn zhòngyào.
example_en: Keeping the classroom clean is important.

en: to put in order; to sort out; to clear away; to tidy up
example_zh: 他把桌子清理了一遍。
example_pinyin: Tā bǎ zhuōzi qīnglǐle yí biàn.
example_en: He sorted out the table once.

en: to sweep; to clean; to give a sweeping
example_zh: 他每天清扫院子。
example_pinyin: Tā měitiān qīngsǎo yuànzi.
example_en: He sweeps the yard every day.

en: distinct; clear; to be clear; clarity
example_zh: 录音里的声音很清晰。
example_pinyin: Lùyīn lǐ de shēngyīn hěn qīngxī.
example_en: The sound on the recording is very clear.

en: to wash; to clean; to rinse
example_zh: 他把水果清洗了一遍。
example_pinyin: Tā bǎ shuǐguǒ qīngxǐle yí biàn.
example_en: He washed the fruit once.

en: sober; clear-headed; to wake up; to be clear-headed; to sober up
example_zh: 休息后他清醒多了。
example_pinyin: Xiūxi hòu tā qīngxǐng duō le.
example_en: After resting he felt much more clear-headed.

example_zh: 这部电影的情节很吸引人。
example_pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de qíngjié hěn xīyǐnrén.
example_en: The plot of this movie is very engaging.

en: situation; state of affairs; circumstances; situation
example_zh: 他描述了当时的情形。
example_pinyin: Tā miáoshùle dāngshí de qíngxing.
example_en: He described the situation at that time.

en: sunny; fine (of weather); clear and bright
example_zh: 今天天气晴朗。
example_pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì qínglǎng.
example_en: The weather is sunny today.

en: to beg; to ask for; to request; to strive for (求)
example_zh: 他向老师求了帮助。
example_pinyin: Tā xiàng lǎoshī qiúle bāngzhù.
example_en: He asked the teacher for help.

en: to propose (marriage); to make an offer of marriage
example_zh: 他在海边向女朋友求婚了。
example_pinyin: Tā zài hǎibiān xiàng nǚpéngyou qiúhūn le.
example_en: He proposed to his girlfriend by the sea.

en: to cry for help; to ask for rescue
example_zh: 有人在水里求救。
example_pinyin: Yǒu rén zài shuǐ lǐ qiújiù.
example_en: Someone is calling for help in the water.

en: to look for a job; to apply for a job
example_zh: 他在网上求职。
example_pinyin: Tā zài wǎngshang qiúzhí.
example_en: He is job hunting online.

en: to seek help; to turn to sb for help
example_zh: 遇到困难可以向朋友求助。
example_pinyin: Yùdào kùnnan kěyǐ xiàng péngyou qiúzhù.
example_en: When in difficulty you can turn to friends for help.

en: to differentiate; to distinguish; to divide; to distinguish
example_zh: 要区分这两个词的意思。
example_pinyin: Yào qūfēn zhè liǎng ge cí de yìsi.
example_en: You should distinguish the meanings of these two words.

en: irrigation ditch; channel; medium; channel of communication
example_zh: 网上购物是新的销售渠道。
example_pinyin: Wǎngshàng gòuwù shì xīn de xiāoshòu qúdào.
example_en: Online shopping is a new sales channel.

example_zh: 他弹了一首钢琴曲。
example_pinyin: Tā tánle yì shǒu gāngqín qǔ.
example_en: He played a piano piece.

en: to replace; to supersede; to displace
example_zh: 网络不能完全取代书本。
example_pinyin: Wǎngluò bùnéng wánquán qǔdài shūběn.
example_en: The internet cannot completely replace books.

en: to marry (of a man); to take to wife (娶)
example_zh: 他去年娶了妻子。
example_pinyin: Tā qùnián qǔle qīzi.
example_en: He got married last year.

example_zh: 这本故事书趣味十足。
example_pinyin: Zhè běn gùshi shū qùwèi shízú.
example_en: This storybook is great fun.

example_zh: 孩子们围成一个圈做游戏。
example_pinyin: Háizimen wéichéng yí ge quān zuò yóuxì.
example_en: The children formed a circle to play a game.
example_cloze: 孩子们围成一个＿＿做游戏。

example_zh: 父母不应该乱用权力。
example_pinyin: Fùmǔ bù yīnggāi luàn yòng quánlì.
example_en: Parents should not misuse their authority.

en: the whole journey; the whole course; whole course
example_zh: 他全程观看了比赛。
example_pinyin: Tā quánchéng guānkànle bǐsài.
example_en: He watched the whole match from beginning to end.

example_zh: 这张券可以打九折。
example_pinyin: Zhè zhāng quàn kěyǐ dǎ jiǔzhé.
example_en: This coupon gives a ten percent discount.

example_zh: 这个产品有两个缺陷。
example_pinyin: Zhège chǎnpǐn yǒu liǎng ge quēxiàn.
example_en: This product has two defects.

en: to establish; to determine; to institute
example_zh: 公司确立了新的目标。
example_pinyin: Gōngsī quèlìle xīn de mùbiāo.
example_en: The company has set new goals.

en: the masses; crowd; community; multitude; masses
example_zh: 公园里聚集了很多群众。
example_pinyin: Gōngyuán lǐ jùjíle hěn duō qúnzhòng.
example_en: A large crowd has gathered in the park.

example_zh: 这种车用天然气当燃料。
example_pinyin: Zhè zhǒng chē yòng tiānránqì dàng ránliào.
example_en: This kind of car uses natural gas as fuel.

en: to dye; to catch (a disease); to acquire (染)
example_zh: 她把头发染成了红色。
example_pinyin: Tā bǎ tóufa rǎnchéngle hóngsè.
example_en: She dyed her hair red.

en: hot spot; point of interest; hot spot
example_zh: 这是大家讨论的热点话题。
example_pinyin: Zhè shì dàjiā tǎolùn de rèdiǎn huàtí.
example_en: This is a hot topic of discussion.

en: temperature (heat); heat; degree of heat; popularity
example_zh: 这个话题的热度很高。
example_pinyin: Zhège huàtí de rèdù hěn gāo.
example_en: This topic is very hot.

en: in great demand; hot; popular; trendy
example_zh: 这是今年最热门的专业。
example_pinyin: Zhè shì jīnnián zuì rèmén de zhuānyè.
example_en: This is the most popular major this year.

example_zh: 浴室里装了热水器。
example_pinyin: Yùshì lǐ zhuāngle rèshuǐqì.
example_en: A water heater is installed in the bathroom.

example_zh: 有问题可以打客服热线。
example_pinyin: Yǒu wèntí kěyǐ dǎ kèfú rèxiàn.
example_en: If you have a problem you can call the customer service hotline.

en: to discuss heatedly; heated discussion; to talk about (热议)
example_zh: 这个新闻在网上被热议。
example_pinyin: Zhège xīnwén zài wǎngshang bèi rèyì.
example_en: This news is being hotly discussed online.

example_zh: 人工智能改变了生活。
example_pinyin: Réngōng zhìnéng gǎibiànle shēnghuó.
example_en: Artificial intelligence has changed life.

en: other people; I (often female); household (人家)
example_zh: 人家的意见要听一听。
example_pinyin: Rénjia de yìjiàn yào tīngyi tīng.
example_en: Other people's opinions are worth listening to.

example_zh: 这个城市人均收入很高。
example_pinyin: Zhège chéngshì rénjūn shōurù hěn gāo.
example_en: The per capita income of this city is high.

en: huge crowds of people; a sea of people
example_zh: 节日的广场人山人海。
example_pinyin: Jiérì de guǎngchǎng rénshān-rénhǎi.
example_en: The square is packed with people during the festival.

example_zh: 他是有名的医学人士。
example_pinyin: Tā shì yǒumíng de yīxué rénshì.
example_en: He is a well-known figure in medicine.

en: personnel; human resources; personnel matters; staffing
example_zh: 她在人事部门工作。
example_pinyin: Tā zài rénshì bùmén gōngzuò.
example_en: She works in the personnel department.

example_zh: 这次事故是人为造成的。
example_pinyin: Zhè cì shìgù shì rénwéi zàochéng de.
example_en: This accident was man-made.

example_zh: 行人请走人行道。
example_pinyin: Xíngrén qǐng zǒu rénxíngdào.
example_en: Pedestrians, please use the sidewalk.

en: to bear; to endure; to stand; to tolerate; to endure
example_zh: 他忍受着疼痛继续工作。
example_pinyin: Tā rěnshòuzhe téngtòng jìxù gōngzuò.
example_en: He endured the pain and kept working.

en: to admit a mistake; to make an apology
example_zh: 他做错了事马上认错。
example_pinyin: Tā zuòcuòle shì mǎshàng rèncuò.
example_en: As soon as he did something wrong he admitted it.

en: to firmly believe; to maintain; to set one's mind on; to affirm; to determine (认定)
example_zh: 他认定了这个目标。
example_pinyin: Tā rèndìngle zhège mùbiāo.
example_en: He set his mind on this goal.

en: to approve; to accept; to approve of; to ratify
example_zh: 他的方案得到了认可。
example_pinyin: Tā de fāng'àn dédàole rènkě.
example_en: His plan was approved.

en: to identify with; to endorse; to identify with; to go along with
example_zh: 大家都认同这个想法。
example_pinyin: Dàjiā dōu rèntóng zhège xiǎngfǎ.
example_en: Everyone agrees with this idea.

en: to know; to recognize; cognition; cognition
example_zh: 孩子对世界的认知在增长。
example_pinyin: Háizi duì shìjiè de rènzhī zài zēngzhǎng.
example_en: The child's understanding of the world is growing.

example_zh: 多年过去，他仍旧很健康。
example_pinyin: Duō nián guòqù, tā réngjiù hěn jiànkāng.
example_en: Many years later he is still in good health.

en: later; in the future; henceforth; hereafter
example_zh: 日后我要当一名医生。
example_pinyin: Rìhòu wǒ yào dāng yì míng yīshēng.
example_en: In the future I want to be a doctor.

en: a few days ago; the other day; the other day
example_zh: 日前他来过我们家。
example_pinyin: Rìqián tā láiguo wǒmen jiā.
example_en: He came to our home a few days ago.

en: day and night; around the clock; night and day
example_zh: 他们日夜准备着比赛。
example_pinyin: Tāmen rìyè zhǔnbèizhe bǐsài.
example_en: They are preparing for the competition day and night.

en: increasingly; more and more; increasingly; day by day
example_zh: 城市的生活日益方便。
example_pinyin: Chéngshì de shēnghuó rìyì fāngbiàn.
example_en: City life is becoming more and more convenient.

example_zh: 他为学校赢得了荣誉。
example_pinyin: Tā wèi xuéxiào yíngdéle róngyù.
example_en: He won honor for the school.

example_zh: 这个水壶的容量是一升。
example_pinyin: Zhège shuǐhú de róngliàng shì yì shēng.
example_en: The capacity of this kettle is one liter.

en: to fuse; to mix; to blend; to harmonize
example_zh: 这两种文化慢慢融合了。
example_pinyin: Zhè liǎng zhǒng wénhuà mànmàn rónghé le.
example_en: The two cultures slowly merged.

en: to melt; to thaw; to melt away
example_zh: 春天的雪很快就融化了。
example_pinyin: Chūntiān de xuě hěn kuài jiù rónghuà le.
example_en: Spring snow melts quickly.

en: to blend into; to integrate into; to mix into; to meld into
example_zh: 他很快融入了新集体。
example_pinyin: Tā hěn kuài róngrùle xīn jítǐ.
example_en: He quickly integrated into the new group.

example_zh: 这条围巾很柔软。
example_pinyin: Zhè tiáo wéijīn hěn róuruǎn.
example_en: This scarf is very soft.

en: to enter a country; to enter the country
example_zh: 入境时要检查护照。
example_pinyin: Rùjìng shí yào jiǎnchá hùzhào.
example_en: Your passport is checked on entry.

en: to enter the gate; to get started; to be initiated; elementary; rudimentary
example_zh: 这是一本汉语入门书。
example_pinyin: Zhè shì yì běn Hànyǔ rùmén shū.
example_en: This is a beginner's Chinese textbook.

en: to be selected; to be chosen; to be picked; to be chosen
example_zh: 他的作品入选了展览。
example_pinyin: Tā de zuòpǐn rùxuǎnle zhǎnlǎn.
example_en: His work was selected for the exhibition.

en: weak point; weakness; weak side; weakness
example_zh: 每个人都有自己的弱点。
example_pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de ruòdiǎn.
example_en: Everyone has their own weaknesses.

en: to scatter; to spill; to sprinkle; to spread (撒)
example_zh: 他在汤里撒了一点儿盐。
example_pinyin: Tā zài tāng lǐ sǎle yìdiǎnr yán.
example_en: He sprinkled a little salt in the soup.

en: to stuff; to squeeze in; to cram; to stop up; to block (塞)
example_zh: 他把信塞进了信封。
example_pinyin: Tā bǎ xìn sāi jìnle xìnfēng.
example_en: He stuffed the letter into the envelope.

example_zh: 今年的足球赛事很多。
example_pinyin: Jīnnián de zúqiú sàishì hěn duō.
example_en: There are many football competitions this year.

en: loose; to come loose; to scatter (散, sǎn)
example_zh: 他的头发有点儿散。
example_pinyin: Tā de tóufa yǒudiǎnr sǎn.
example_en: His hair is a bit loose.

example_zh: 他喜欢写散文。
example_pinyin: Tā xǐhuan xiě sǎnwén.
example_en: He likes writing essays.

en: to disperse; to dismiss; to break up; to disperse (散, sàn)
example_zh: 会议散了以后大家回家。
example_pinyin: Huìyì sànle yǐhòu dàjiā huí jiā.
example_en: After the meeting breaks up everyone goes home.
